title: Nancy S NDE 22979
content: I had gotten to the top of the stairs and put my hand on the door knob. Then I saw myself going down. I felt like my head was cracked open but, it had lots of lumps. My arm and wrist where broken.

elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes My head had lumps and my arm and wrist broken my wrist was all twisted
elements.At what time during the experience were: All I remember is seeing my head. Then I was down the end of the stairs. People heard me scream an unnerving sound. I remember nothing but watching.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Scared. I thought I was watching myself die.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I saw myself falling down I watched it
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: I am glad I had the experience because it feels like God is taking care of me. I am not alone
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Not sure any one believes me
